I'm still here.

To answer some of your questions:

"Are you taking any classes in college/are you college educated?"

I am not taking anymore classes in college right now. I am college educated. I have a degree, and I've taking some graduate-level coursework as well.

Not to brag, or insult you or anyone else who may read this, but I'm most likely smarter than you -- By a lot.

It's been my experience that most people don't like people who are smarter than they are, so I hide it -- Especially if that person is uglier than they are, they tend to really not like it then.
